# StealthEye Agent OS LLM index

StealthEye Agent OS is a public-safe TypeScript foundation for mission-scoped autonomous online work. It uses signed manifests, Guard capability boundaries, Worker Fleet task contracts, CodeOps/CI Repair contracts, fixture-only BrowserOps contracts, receipts, evals, and generated build state.

## Current build

Build 8: BrowserOps Foundations + Minimal Build Automation Engine.

## Packages

- `@stealtheye/agent-registry`: signed manifest primitives.
- `@stealtheye/guard`: capability tokens, requested actions, hard stops, decisions, and receipts.
- `@stealtheye/mission-os`: Mission Language, authority envelopes, plans, and status.
- `@stealtheye/app-host`: fixture-backed ChatGPT App / MCP host descriptors.
- `@stealtheye/worker-fleet`: task, lease, idempotency, retry, artifact, receipt, and preflight contracts.
- `@stealtheye/codeops`: branch-safe repository/CI contracts.
- `@stealtheye/browserops`: fixture-only browser sessions, observations, evidence refs, action policies, action plans, Guard preflight, and Worker Fleet templates.

## Build automation

- Engine: `scripts/stealtheye-build.mjs`
- Phase spec: `scripts/phases/build-008-browserops.mjs`
- Generated state: `docs/generated/`

## Hard boundaries

Do not add secrets, credentials, private endpoints, customer data, live browser automation, credentialed browsing, material external sends, purchases/payments, money movement, destructive actions, production mutation, protected branch mutation, force push/history rewrite, or CI/test/security weakening.

Next target: Build 9 — Receipts + Replay.
